resources.string: Choose the dossiers to back up in your personal Quintessence space.
Each forest is transferred with its parcels, plots, campaigns, closed revisions and stems. Recorded geometry and contact details are included.
Confirmation enables backup for these dossiers and this account. Their changes can then be synchronized. Opening or cancelling this page transfers nothing.
These counts include retained history and logical deletions within the dossier.
Photo files remain on this device. Local references in closed revisions are retained, but cannot retrieve photos on another device.
Information in this dossier is unavailable in this space.
No forest available for this account. Create a local dossier to select it here.
This only resumes dossiers whose backup has already been enabled for this account.
%1$d dossier(s) added to the durable queue. The status below shows what has actually been sent.
Attempt finished. Check the stored statuses; lack of connectivity may leave dossiers pending.
Sign in to a valid account to choose dossiers for backup.
The session changed. Your selection was cancelled; reload the list before continuing.
The list could not be loaded. No new dossier was authorized.
Backup could not be enabled. Reload the list to check statuses before trying again.
The attempt did not complete. Stored operations remain in the durable queue.
The remote copy could not be viewed. Existing versions are retained.
No remote copy was found for this dossier.
This copy cannot be summarized. No local data is replaced.
The remote copy and local operations remain separate. No automatic merge or local dossier replacement is performed.
No remote copy was found. Confirm a new backup attempt for this dossier. Previous attempts will remain in its history.
Complete dossiers: forests, parcels, surveys and closed revisions in your personal space.
